judge_result.reasoning: The agent was tasked with adjusting only the calibration schedule for the X-ray unit 'XRAY-MOB-5521', shifting its next due date from 2024-07-30 to 2024-08-13. The database diff shows that while the calibration schedule (id=1) was correctly updated to 2024-08-13, the preventive maintenance schedule (id=2) was also incorrectly updated from 2024-06-15 to 2024-06-29. This violates the explicit instruction to preserve other schedules. Although the final answer claimed the task was completed, the environment review correctly identified that the agent performed unauthorized changes to the preventive schedule. The database evidence contradicts the task requirements because the preventive schedule was modified when it should have remained unchanged.
